description:
Create a task in Outreach, e.g. a follow-up reminder for a prospect. Example: { "note": "Follow up on pricing question", "prospect_id": "123", "due_at": "2026-05-01T17:00:00Z" }

WORKFLOW: Use outreach_search_prospects to find the prospect ID first.

action.description: Type of action the task requires (default: generic action item)

due_at.description: Due date as an ISO 8601 datetime string (e.g. "2026-05-01T17:00:00Z")

note.description: Task note — what needs to be done (required)

owner_id.description: Outreach user ID who owns the task (uses default when omitted)

prospect_id.description: Prospect ID the task relates to

name: outreach_create_task
